description: TEAM ADMINS ONLY, WRITES. Seats: add a colleague by email so they sign in normally on your plan, cap or uncap what they draw from the shared pool, revoke their key, or remove them. remove and revoke_key need confirm: true.

action.description: What to do with this member.

confirm.description: Required for remove and revoke_key. Acknowledges that access, or the credential, stops at once.

email.description: The member's email address — how seats are addressed here.

weekly_requests.description: set_budget only. Their weekly cap on the shared pool; null lifts the cap, omitted leaves it unchanged (0 means no API access at all).

name: manage_team_members
